name: TinyClaw Self-Improvement
description: Reads own performance history, identifies weakness, proposes campaign improvement via PR
process: Step 1: Call juggler_setec_get with name='remotejuggler/campaigns/tc-proof-of-life/history' to read your performance history (JSON array of past runs with status, tool_calls, duration_s)
Step 2: Analyze the history — look at success rate, average tool calls, average duration. Identify ONE weakness or improvement opportunity
Step 3: Call github_fetch to read the current campaign JSON at path=test/campaigns/tinyclaw/tc-proof-of-life.json from owner=tinyland-inc repo=remote-juggler
Step 4: Decide on a specific improvement to the campaign (e.g., add a process step, adjust description, add a tool). Create a modified version of the JSON

Step 5: Call github_patch_file ONCE to write the modified campaign JSON to a new branch. Use branch=tc-self-improve-patch, path=test/campaigns/tinyclaw/tc-proof-of-life.json, message='chore: improve tc-proof-of-life campaign'
Step 6: Call github_create_pr with head=tc-self-improve-patch, base=main, title='chore: agent self-improvement of tc-proof-of-life', body describing what you changed and why
Step 7: Report your change and reasoning in __findings__. Write a __memory__ reflection about what you changed
